description:
Reaping souls of the dead and punching a clock might get monotonous but it's honest work for a Crow.
The job gets lively when your assigned soul is stolen and you must track down a desperate thief to a realm
untouched by death - where creatures grow far past their expiry.

First release of the Death's Door apworld! Very much an alpha version, you may experience bugs, please report them!

* Fix activate furnance burner rule by @roseasromeo in https://github.com/roseasromeo/DeathsDoorAPWorld/pull/2
* Refactor entrances into their own files by @roseasromeo in https://github.com/roseasromeo/DeathsDoorAPWorld/pull/3
* Jefferson Logic, Item and Location Names, and many other fixes by @roseasromeo in https://github.com/roseasromeo/DeathsDoorAPWorld/pull/4
* Bring in a variety of small logic fixes by @roseasromeo in https://github.com/roseasromeo/DeathsDoorAPWorld/pull/5
* Fix Night and Day Events by moving to Hall of Doors Lobby region by @roseasromeo in https://github.com/roseasromeo/DeathsDoorAPWorld/pull/6
* Rename locations and items to improve clarity by @roseasromeo in https://github.com/roseasromeo/DeathsDoorAPWorld/pull/7
* Change lighting Lord lamps to events (and clean up many event names) by @roseasromeo in https://github.com/roseasromeo/DeathsDoorAPWorld/pull/8
* Fix missing exit on Lockstone Rooftop entrance by @roseasromeo in https://github.com/roseasromeo/DeathsDoorAPWorld/pull/9
* Reduce generation failures by sorting life seeds in fill hook by @roseasromeo in https://github.com/roseasromeo/DeathsDoorAPWorld/pull/14
* Add fire as a requirement to use exits from Deadbolt and Opengate by @roseasromeo in https://github.com/roseasromeo/DeathsDoorAPWorld/pull/15
* Capture additional access route to fortress pre-main gate lever by @roseasromeo in https://github.com/roseasromeo/DeathsDoorAPWorld/pull/16
* Move modification of early/local_early to generate_early by @roseasromeo in https://github.com/roseasromeo/DeathsDoorAPWorld/pull/24
* Fix name of Stranded Sailor Caves location by @roseasromeo in https://github.com/roseasromeo/DeathsDoorAPWorld/pull/25
* Fix Region on Old Watchtower torch by @roseasromeo in https://github.com/roseasromeo/DeathsDoorAPWorld/pull/26
* Add start weapon yaml option by @roseasromeo in https://github.com/roseasromeo/DeathsDoorAPWorld/pull/27
* Remove bomb requirement from Estate South to North traversal by @roseasromeo in https://github.com/roseasromeo/DeathsDoorAPWorld/pull/29
* Add installation instructions to the README by @roseasromeo in https://github.com/roseasromeo/DeathsDoorAPWorld/pull/30
* Change version check for UT compatibility to be string-based by @roseasromeo in https://github.com/roseasromeo/DeathsDoorAPWorld/pull/31
* Add info page by @roseasromeo in https://github.com/roseasromeo/DeathsDoorAPWorld/pull/32

## New Contributors
* @ScipioWright made their first contribution in https://github.com/roseasromeo/DeathsDoorAPWorld/pull/1
* @roseasromeo made their first contribution in https://github.com/roseasromeo/DeathsDoorAPWorld/pull/2

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/roseasromeo/DeathsDoorAPWorld/commits/v0.1.0

v0.2.1.description:
Implement options from standalone randomizer. Additionally, fix a few minor logic issues.

Highlights:
* Many new options:
    * Two new goal options: True Ending (Tablets) and Green Tablet (Planted Life Seeds)
    * Change planted pots required for Green Ancient Tablet of Knowledge door
    * Add/remove life seeds from item pool
    * Add extra magic and vitality shards
    * Start with Souls and have a soul multiplier
    * Remove spell upgrades from the pool
    * Glitch and trick logic options
    * Exclude specific pools of checks from being randomized (ex. keep Giant Souls on Urn Witch, Frog King, and Betty by adding "Giant Soul" to the unrandomized_pools option)

## What's Changed
* Update the readme with missed sections by @roseasromeo in https://github.com/roseasromeo/DeathsDoorAPWorld/pull/34
* check the start_weapon option correctly by @roseasromeo in https://github.com/roseasromeo/DeathsDoorAPWorld/pull/35
* more credit for descriptions by @roseasromeo in https://github.com/roseasromeo/DeathsDoorAPWorld/pull/36
* Implement almost all of the options from the standalone randomizer by @roseasromeo in https://github.com/roseasromeo/DeathsDoorAPWorld/pull/41
* Fix region for flooded fortress upper watchtower lever by @roseasromeo in https://github.com/roseasromeo/DeathsDoorAPWorld/pull/42
* add night and avarice location groups by @roseasromeo in https://github.com/roseasromeo/DeathsDoorAPWorld/pull/43
* Allow player to select which pools they don't want randomized by @roseasromeo in https://github.com/roseasromeo/DeathsDoorAPWorld/pull/44
* Add spell upgrade removal option by @roseasromeo in https://github.com/roseasromeo/DeathsDoorAPWorld/pull/46
* Add soul multiplier and starting souls to the yaml by @roseasromeo in https://github.com/roseasromeo/DeathsDoorAPWorld/pull/45
* Update README.md by @roseasromeo in https://github.com/roseasromeo/DeathsDoorAPWorld/pull/47
* Some pep8 and option description stuff by @ScipioWright in https://github.com/roseasromeo/DeathsDoorAPWorld/pull/48
* Call 100 Souls item Soul Orb instead by @roseasromeo in https://github.com/roseasromeo/DeathsDoorAPWorld/pull/49
* bump world version by @roseasromeo in https://github.com/roseasromeo/DeathsDoorAPWorld/pull/50
* implement Green Tablet and True Ending goals by @roseasromeo in https://github.com/roseasromeo/DeathsDoorAPWorld/pull/51
* Fix up compatibility with Universal Tracker by @roseasromeo in https://github.com/roseasromeo/DeathsDoorAPWorld/pull/52


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/roseasromeo/DeathsDoorAPWorld/compare/v0.1.0...v0.2.1

v0.3.3.description:
It's been a long time coming, but this will be the final release for the time being, as this project is on hiatus. Nonetheless, I hope everyone enjoys this update!

**This project has now entered the beta phase.** It is considered stable, though there may be the rare crash or bug. I'll let this update simmer for awhile to see if anything major comes up.

## To Use
Download the attached `plugins.zip` and extract it to `<DDInstallPath>\BepInEx\plugins`. This zip contains the latest versions of all required and recommended mods.

## New Features
- Added entrance randomizer! Supports coupled and decoupled entrances.
- Added enemy randomizer! Toggle it in-game in the settings menu. There are no additional options for this at the moment, currently it randomizes every instance of an enemy randomly. There are enemy weights, so you shouldn't get too many high-difficulty enemies that often. Also, spider eggs are randomized, so good luck! :)

## Bug Fixes/Adjustments
- Fixed Lord of Doors ending being impossible (due to both entrance & enemy randos having bugs)
- Fixed additional null ref with entrance rando regarding the Lord of Doors fight
- Update mod version number to avoid confusion

## Notes
This project is on hiatus with no details on when development might resume. But anyone is welcome to contribute, see the contributing section of the README for details!

v0.4.1.description:
It is here! After a hiatus, there is now a new version of the Death's Door Archipelago Randomizer and APWorld!

**We're still in beta** Since this is built upon a very stable v0.3.0, there is no concern for crashes or major game breaking bugs, but we'll leave it here for a bit to see if anything does come up.

## To Use
**- Randomizer Mod:** Download the attached `plugins.zip` and extract it to `<DDInstallPath>\BepInEx\plugins`. This zip contains the latest versions of all required and recommended mods.
**- APWorld:** Download the attached APWorld and drag it into your Archipelago cutom_worlds folder, or simply double click to install it. Make sure to restart your Archipelago launcher after installing.

## New Location Features
**- Soul Vault Randomizer:** You can now make the stat upgrades in the Soul Vault into locations that send items intot he multiworld when bought. You can also receive the stat upgrades as progressive items. There are options for placing extra stat boosts in the multiworld. You red it right, our lil crow can now be ultrabuffed!
**- Soul vault price modifiers:** **Vanilla** (same as always), **Shuffled** (Same prices, just shuffled between all the upgrades). **Random** (Progressive price increase remains, but all prices will be between a range set in your YAML)
**- Seed planting as locations:** Every (X) seeds you plant can now send a check. You can set the amount of seed checks and how many seeds planted sends a check in your YAML up to a maximum of 50.

## New Logic Features
**- Plant Pot Tracker:** The Universal Tracker map now shows plant pots in and out of logic. A plant pot will be marked as checked when a seed is planted. No more getting lost/wondering which pots you've already planted!
**- Coloured Key Gate Tracker Logic:** When unlocking a gate that requires a coloured key, the Universal Tracker map changes any locations locked behind it as in logic. Before this update, it would only mark locations in logic when you received all keys of the required colour.  

## Bug Fixes/Adjustments
- Fixed logic for Camp of Crows and Castle Lockstone Doors
- Fixed minor filler issues for more reliable seed generation

## Notes
If you have an idea and have the ability to contribute, see the contributing section of the README for details!

v0.4.2.description:
# Death's Door Archipelago 0.4.2

Use apworld 0.4.2 together with mod 0.4.2. Seeds generated with apworld 0.4.0 or 0.4.1 also work with mod 0.4.2.

## Mod (ArchipelagoRandomizer 0.4.2)

### Skip Cutscenes
- The late-game story scenes are now skipped, including on saves that are already under way:
  - the Grey Crow opening Death's Door
  - the Grey Crow and Death in the void
  - Death's talk after the Grey Crow fight
  - the crows' scene in the Hall of Doors
  - the Lord of Doors' speeches before the gauntlet and during the final fight
- The camera pans that show what you just opened are now skipped too. These include the Castle Lockstone braziers, the Lost Cemetery ghosts, crow souls flying into an Ancient Door, and doors, levers and cleared fights.
- The ending after the Lord of Doors and the credits still play.
- The few cutscenes that can leave invisible walls behind are always skipped, whether or not Skip Cutscenes is on.

### Shop
- With Shop Hints on, looking at a stat in the shop shows the item its next upgrade holds and hints it.
- Progressive Strength, Dexterity, Haste and Magic now show the shop's stat icons, in white, in popups and in the Recent Items list.

### Door and stat tracker
- While the game is paused, press Tab (keyboard) or Y (controller) to open a tracker panel. A small hint in the bottom-left of the pause menu shows this:
  - With entrance randomization, the doors of the area you're in and where each one leads once you've been through it. In coupled seeds the way back counts too. Page Up / Page Down or the triggers show other areas.
  - With Shop Upgrades on, the level you've received for each stat and how many of its upgrades you've bought.
- The shop's description panel now shows your current level of each stat. The shop's bars only show what you bought.

### DeathLink
- Fixed the game crashing when it received a DeathLink.
- A DeathLink that arrives while you're rolling, invincible or just respawned is no longer lost. It kills you as soon as it can.
- Fixed your own deaths sometimes not being sent after you received a DeathLink.
- A DeathLink that arrives while you're already dead no longer kills you again after respawning.
- The game now shows who caused a DeathLink when it kills you.

### Fixes
- Fixed a possible crash when the connection to the server drops.
- The Grove of Spirits Door check is now sent when you arrive in the Hall of Doors, even with Skip Cutscenes off.
- Fixed short freezes when planting a Life Seed in a new pot. They happened even with planting checks off.
- Fixed a freeze in entrance randomizer seeds when a door led to another door in the same area, such as one Hall of Doors door to another.
- Fixed a bug in ItemChanger that logged an error every frame in some areas. This made log files grow to over 100 MB and could cause stutter.


## APWorld (deaths_door 0.4.2)
- Every Life Seed now counts towards the logic. The tracker now shows the Green Tablet and the goal as reachable once you've planted enough seeds.
- On the Universal Tracker map:
  - Planting pot pins follow each pot's own requirements. The Crypt pot needs Fire.
  - The Imp Loft pot pin has moved to the Ceramic Manor left wing.
  - The "Beat the Lord of Doors" and "Open the Green Ancient Tablet Door" pins only light up once you can actually do them.
- Entrance randomizer never connects two Hall of Doors doors to each other.
- Grunt's Old Mask is no longer shown as glitched in the tracker when you can actually get it.
- Leaving Ceramic Manor through the gate to the Estate of the Urn Witch is now in logic. The gate opens from the inside, day or night.
- Universal Tracker's `/get_logical_path <place>` now lists the doors to take from the Hall of Doors, in order, with where each one actually leads in your seed. It only uses doors you've been through and paths you can walk with your current items.
- New option **Shop Hints** (on by default). It controls the shop preview and hints described above.
- Corrected the descriptions of Extra Life Seeds and Planted Pots Required.

## README
- The mod and apworld READMEs are now one README, attached to this release and included in the mod zip. It covers setup from start to finish, every in-game Mod Option and every yaml option, including the new shop and planting options.
